Picking the right employer, taking the right commissions, doing what's required, and never signing long-term contracts. Then even if you switch sides to work for the competition, your former employer can't say a thing."
"Pulchra, someone else came looking for trouble just now. I sent them packing. How did you manage to make so many enemies?"

Below it, there's a slightly smaller note with big black letters that reads: Caesar, you'd better pay for breaking my lock! 100,000 Dennies!
Under the black letters, there's a crooked line of small text: I asked Proxy, lock's only worth 20,000!

"Man, this game's AI is way too weak. Boring."

Pulchra's earliest blurry childhood memory was of a warm, big tail. When she first learned to crawl, she loved to chase after it.
"And then what?"
"They tell me it was my own tail."
But Pulchra knew it wasn't hers. Aside from the tail game, at night, it would wrap tightly around her, keeping her warm through each cold night. Maybe the Hollow took it, or maybe something else... But it doesn't matter - she stopped playing that game long ago.

Amid countless diverging paths, she resolutely chose the one that led to your side.
And today, she finally stands with her shadow overlapping yours.
And today, the sunset remains unchanged.

talent_text.Jufufu_Talent_01_Desc_02:
"The topic of farewells and life and death is too difficult for children to understand, too heavy for adults to bear, and too cruel for the elderly."
"But I'm not afraid — I'm the fearless Tiger Thiren who learned this lesson early."
"I'm a super scary big tiger, little critters, so please don't look directly into my eyes!"

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, character CRIT DMG increases by an additional 22%.

talent_text.Jufufu_Talent_02_Desc_02:
"The techniques Shifu taught me are truly amazing, though it can't compare to those of fairy tales and legend."
"If I were a little stronger — just a little stronger — could I rewrite those fated pasts, like in the stories and legends?
"At first, I was just as puzzled, but once you grasp the trick, it's actually quite simple! Let me teach you, Junior!"
talent_text.Jufufu_Talent_02_Desc_01: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, character CRIT DMG increases by an additional 22%. Whenever any character activates an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Ju Fufu gains 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color>.

talent_text.Jufufu_Talent_03_Desc_02:
"Good or evil, in that moment, perhaps it's all just a matter of a single thought. A single thought leaves behind so many regrets, so many 'what ifs' — and so much sacrifice and love."
"I'm not smart, I don't understand many of those grand principles, so I just do what I think is right."
"Wherever the great hero Fufu goes, there's justice!"

talent_text.Jufufu_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: While Ju Fufu is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.
talent_text.Jufufu_Talent_04_Desc_02:
"Ethereals are terrifying, bandits are terrifying, Hollow Raiders are terrifying, the dark night without stars is terrifying — and yet, I'm the most powerful mystic of Yunkui Summit. I cannot retreat, I cannot let my story repeat."
"The dark and gloom is a blanketing shroud, unbearable for mountain, moon, and cloud."
"I am the strongest mystic of Yunkui Summit, evil spirits and demons, meet your end!"
talent_text.Jufufu_Talent_04_Desc_01: While Ju Fufu is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.

talent_text.Jufufu_Talent_05_Desc_02:
"No need to fear — your senior is here!"
"The hero I longed for when I was a child never came, but I won't make you wait — I will be your hero."
"You can bully me, but not my juniors! I'll take you on! Rwaar!"

talent_text.Jufufu_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
Ju Fufu's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> DMG increases by 30%.
Upon consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> and hitting an enemy in the high-speed spinning state, fire 3 popcorns, each dealing 160% of Fufu's ATK as DMG. This DMG is treated as <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> DMG.
talent_text.Jufufu_Talent_06_Desc_02:
"My might shakes the moon down from the mountain, my aura levels caves — how's this line? Does it capture the grandeur of my imposing presence?"
"The name of a hero doesn't matter, their regrets don't matter, their tears don't matter, and even the inevitable farewell doesn't matter."
"As long as you remember, I once roared with bravery."

This Yunkui technique wards off the external flow of Ether while reinforcing your inner meridians and muscles. With qi acting as a shield, no blade or spear can pierce it — this is Pan Yinhu's secret to enduring every blow.
Side note: this trick comes in extra handy when you're elbow-to-elbow with aunties and uncles fighting over supermarket sale items.

talent_text.PanYinhu_Talent_02_Desc_01_Realign: For every 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Break Force</color> consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the <color=#FFFFFF>Depleted Qi</color> effect applied when <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Touch of Death</color> hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.
talent_text.PanYinhu_Talent_02_Desc_02:
"Heh, can't move an inch now, can you, thief?"
"This technique is called Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike — it both paralyzes the body and clears the meridians — it's our sect's ultimate technique for punishing evil and upholding justice!"
"...Eh? You mean my grip was so strong that you just went numb? ...Alright then — can you move or not?"

talent_text.PanYinhu_Talent_03_Desc_02:
"These pressure points are a lot like us Panda Thirens."
"They're few and scattered, don't fit into any one system, and hardly anyone's ever studied them. It's a shame."
"But they really catch people off guard as a surprise weapon. Pretty great, right?"

On activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!</color>, gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Backup Provisions</color> effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Backup Provisions</color> effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!</color>'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.
talent_text.PanYinhu_Talent_04_Desc_02:
The first time he cooked, he nearly set the stove on fire. Among those who rushed to help was a chef who, looking at the pile of burnt food, used the unused eggs to make him a plate of fried rice.
He wolfed it down with tears in his eyes. When he finally looked up, the cook was holding out a slip of paper with "100" written on it.
"I understand, Master! You're teaching me in cooking, you have to give it 100%, right?" "No, I'm saying it's 100 Dennies per bite, and you've had over a hundred bites. Time to pay up."
From that day on, Pan Yinhu insisted on cooking for himself and never messed up again. And that's how a first-class chef was born.

talent_text.PanYinhu_Talent_05_Desc_02:
In the sprawling city of New Eridu, Panda Thirens are extremely rare. He's always bristled at curious stares and long ago gotten used to living a lonely life with nobody to support him.
It wasn't until he became an apprentice on Yunkui Summit that he stopped feeling so isolated.
And once he realized that many citizens would even pay to take a photo with a Panda Thiren... he no longer minded the stares.

talent_text.PanYinhu_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign: The <color=#FFFFFF>Meridian Flow</color> effect provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment</color> increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.
talent_text.PanYinhu_Talent_06_Desc_02:
"There's an old saying that there are 365 pressure points in the feet. Funny — it's the same with how we live our lives."
"Here — pick whichever point you like from this chart."
"That point represents your current way of life — where it is or what it does doesn't matter. As long as you like it, that's enough."
"And what good is choosing it, you ask? Let me think... Ah, of course. Next time I deal with some thieves, that's the point I'll target!"

talent_text.Zhenzhen_Talent_01_Desc_02:
Countless times, in the dead of night, she finds herself returning to that day...
Steel cried out, the sword acknowledged its wielder, and a contract was forged.
Was it a blessing, or a curse?

...No one knows the answer. Yet from that day on, her fate became bound to the sword.

talent_text.Zhenzhen_Talent_02_Desc_02:
Time flowed on, winters giving way to summers.
Her entire world amounted to this tiny stretch of Yunkui Summit, the changing seasons of the mountain were all she would ever see.
In endless solitude and ever-present fear, "another self" quietly came into being.

"...I am a part of her. From beginning to end, we were never apart."
"If she is the light, then I am the shadow. If she stands as a lofty idol, then I am the mortal who crawls below."
"Unlike her, I have no wish to become some kind of 'hero'..."
"...I just want to survive."

talent_text.Zhenzhen_Talent_03_Desc_02:
A peerless famed sword lies hidden deep in the mountains, its edge fully restrained.
But once unsheathed, its icy light reaches far and wide, even after storms of wind and snow, a single piercing light endures.

"What is someone who wields a blade?"
"Nothing more than... the courage to press forward without hesitation, and the resolve to cut through anything."

Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
The Vulnerability bonus provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is increased to a maximum of 200%.
talent_text.Zhenzhen_Talent_04_Desc_02:
Hidden beneath a grand vision was a lie, where salvation came only by burning oneself to ash.
Fate showed her no mercy, yet she willingly met her end.

"I understand."
"I will live my whole life alongside 'loss'."
"I willingly accept everything..."
"...This is the person I choose to be."

talent_text.Zhenzhen_Talent_05_Desc_02:
"...I suppose, in the end, I'm still that 'lucky' child."
"Miasma won't overwhelm me, disaster won't swallow me."
"Even the Qingming Sword can't drag me into that pitch-black, bottomless abyss..."

"My brother, Shifu, everyone at Suibian Temple... and you."
"...I know you'll all keep waiting for me."
And so, even if the road ahead is filled with thorns, a faint light still guides the way.

When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Lantern Wish</color>, stacking up to 4 times.

talent_text.Zhenzhen_Talent_06_Desc_02:
Once, she stood alone, walking through the dark.
Then she took up her sword and rushed toward disaster. As Qingming left its sheath, a fleeting arc of light split the sky, illuminating that silent, shadowed land.

"...I want to be one light among countless fireflies."
"The sun will rise. No matter how long the night lasts, dawn always comes."
"In the distant past, and in the distant future, there must be countless others who made the same choice as me. We... were never alone."

talent_text.Yidhari_Talent_01_Desc_02:
She plunged into an unfathomable abyss.
—What is this place, and where will it carry her?
The moment doubt arose, a voice whispered from the darkness:
"This is the realm of the unknown, opening the path to all that is known."
Endless shadows tumbled down with her.
—Who are they, and why do their shadows fall here?
As the question rose in her thoughts, the voice replied once more:
"They are those cut off from fate. What falls here are the remnants of their past."
And so, the little girl hugged herself in solitude, carried downward by countless bygone memories.
Her eyes widened in bewilderment, seeing only cold, stillness, and loneliness blooming at the bottom of the abyss.

talent_text.Yidhari_Talent_02_Desc_02:
In the darkness lay the girl's slumbering thoughts.
They were not innocent daydreams, nor carefree flights of fancy.
Her mind was fixed on the memories she had witnessed.
"What must I do? What must I bear?"
"Good thing it's me, and not someone else."
"I know how to deal with being alone... I think."
As she sifted through those pasts, the girl calmly accepted this heavy gift.

talent_text.Yidhari_Talent_03_Desc_02:
So this is what humanity is — such a complex existence.
A lifetime can hold so much joy, and just as much sorrow.
Yet now, all of it has fallen into this void, to be swallowed, erased, and buried.
No one will ever care again for those joyful laughs, or those grief-stricken cries.
Still... every one of those untold stories has been etched into this abyss of the soul.

talent_text.Yidhari_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign:
Yidhari gains 10% more Decibels when losing HP for <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Dreamscape Collection</color>.
While in <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, Yidhari's Max HP is further increased by 5%.
talent_text.Yidhari_Talent_04_Desc_02:
The flower trembled as it bloomed in the dark, white and translucent, as though it reflected the lone light of the abyss's depths.
—It was, in truth, a soul, fragile yet unyielding.
Amid the countless falling shadows, amid the flood of cascading memories... she remained untouched, still blooming with her own strength.
But in the end... will she too fade away, drifting with nothing to hold on to?
talent_text.Yidhari_Talent_04_Desc_01: Yidhari gains 10% more Decibels when losing HP for <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Dreamscape Collection</color>. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, Yidhari's Max HP is further increased by 5%.

talent_text.Yidhari_Talent_05_Desc_02:
"Such beautiful eyes... am I still inside a dream?"
It was their first meeting, and her first brush with something real.
Amid the emptiness and the grotesque, in the barren abyss that threatened to devour everything, she caught sight of those eyes.
They were like a hint of green breaking through the burning desert, like a clear spring rising from a parched riverbed.
"I think I've found it... the hope of someone who will willingly respond to me."

talent_text.Yidhari_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:

talent_text.Yidhari_Talent_06_Desc_02:
Immersed in the tide of memories, she had never found even fleeting rest.
Her only refuge was solitude, escaping the bustle of the world, losing herself in strange tales, seeking quiet beneath veils of misty rain or within the embrace of warm waters.
But now, she can walk calmly among the crowds, no longer troubled by noise or the burning sun, for "illusion" no longer binds her spirit, and "reality" has become the anchor of her soul.

talent_text.Alice_Talent_01_Desc_02:
A sprig of coriander sways like a newborn green star,
So fragile her fingertips felt they might pass through it.
She slowly opened her trembling hands,
And held that flicker of feeling in her palms.
Her heart beat like a spring bud breaking the earth at dawn, just after the rain.

talent_text.Alice_Talent_02_Desc_02:
The silver blade dips low, kissing the frost-lined sage leaf.
This pre-battle salute is the girl's quiet show of composure.
Fear and helplessness lie frozen in the faded dreams of yesterday.
Her sword stirs, ready to trace the outline of the stars.
Dawn is near, and the flower bud waits to bloom.

talent_text.Alice_Talent_03_Desc_02:
She couldn't resist perfect symmetry.
In symmetry, there was order, balance, and meaning. Without it, her bunny ears and tail would dull and droop, as if something lovely were about to vanish from her world.
"So... that's why you had to bring up my mismatched socks, and tried to take off my leg band?"
"I just can't stand your asymmetry! Just for a second, I swear — just one second!"

talent_text.Alice_Talent_04_Desc_02:
The scent of rosemary lingered between her lips,
A vow searing and resolute, carried on every breath of frost.
Even as the air in her lungs turned cold and heavy,
The girl would never forget the spell called love.
"In the name of the Thymefields... I will never betray it."

talent_text.Alice_Talent_05_Desc_02:
She couldn't resist scary paranormal things.
Within the paranormal hid the unknown and the dangerous. When she felt it, her bunny ears and tail would bristle in fright — only to become irresistibly smooth once she calmed down.

The school doesn't even have a name, he isn't looking for fame for fortune, and he's never once told his students to shout slogans about passing down his art.
Only Banyue Shifu himself knows that the obsession called repentance burns that iron heart, day and night. A single mistake could send him spiralling.

"Greed is like fire. When kept in check, it lights the way forward, but left unchecked, it burns you instead."

After all, how could a mountain ever grow angry? Its deep, immovable calm makes people almost forget the fury it can hold.

Banyue Shifu was not just a warrior, but a wise man — or so said both his students and the neighbors who knew him.
After all, he always looked so composed and thoughtful. Though he spoke little, every word that left his mouth sounded like a proverb worth pondering.
Martial arts, he often said, are not only a way to train the body but also the heart. And as he would always add, he himself was still just a student.

"I, Banyue, have been slow and foolish, once straying from the right path. But to clear the way for you on this journey... these fists are still yours to command."

Fate may be ordained by the heavens or shaped by human hands. Yet for some, destiny and guilt were never granted the mercy of free will.
Before ever having a name, the combat construct known as "Type Zero" was, in the truest sense, nothing more than a killing machine.
And when did a "heart" form? Was it the day she erased the chains of his code, or the moment he found the courage to carry it all and keep moving forward?

"Repentance is too easy. Rather than fleeing from past sins, shoulder the mountain of your past... and throw a punch."

The students there are no joke; they can even hold their own against Ethereals.
Their iron-bodied Shifu often heads into the Hollows to help with rescues, too. Must be quite the martial arts master, huh?

"I'm still just a clumsy student myself... Though you all call me 'Shifu,' it's you who have taught me what it means to be a person."

Which day did it end, though? The first time I heard the whispers of the dead? When I was sent into the Hollow as a sacrifice? Or that first night I cried myself to sleep?

Such foolish choices always lead to regret. My job is simply to use yesterday's regrets to make today's a little lighter.

"I'm not like them. I—I'm a lonely genius!"
She puffed out her cheeks and quietly wiped away the lonely tear that slipped from the corner of her eye.

Having heard such remarks all her life, she stopped hoping for any other kind of judgment.

Ah... so she had always been seeking this sense of being understood. Always... waiting for someone she could call a friend.
Even having grown accustomed to loneliness from endless practice, humans are still, in the end, social animals. That person lifted her out of damp, clinging solitude, and from then on, she had a shelter made of feathers.

"Those gentle songs gave me strength."
"Finding music I could resonate with at my saddest moment was so moving..."
"This style of music is so cute!!"
The girl stares nervously at the screen. The small red dot marking new messages quivers along with her heartbeat, as she opens the same window over and over again—
Just a little more... just a few more people seeing my music... a few more people seeing me, someone who's good for nothing but writing music...
All I want is for a few more people to take power from this.

Like a dream, like playing house... in the end, it all belonged to the realm of "delusion."
The moment they walked out, they were no longer three separate individuals, but a group: the Angels of Delusion. And the moment she walked out, she stopped being only Sunna, the songwriter working behind the scenes, and became an idol standing before her fans, expressing herself onstage.
—This overwhelming delusion descending upon her was the most incredible gift she had ever known.

The stars were strung across the night like gas lamps lit at dusk.
She imagined that somewhere in the vast galaxy, someone was driving a clattering electric tram, setting off from pale morning light and heading straight toward infinity.
The passengers were all adorable little creatures like cats, dogs, and bunnies, and the conductor was fluent in the languages of deep-sea fish and owls.
Leaving behind the rush of everyday life, stepping away from mundane routines—
"If I could borrow the wings of the Angels of Delusion, maybe I could bring everyone into a world of music like this!"
Surrounded by the sugary aroma of a scented candle, she stretched with a soft yawn, then wrote this romantic dream onto the sheet music.

It felt as if they were angels, with wings capable of carrying everyone away from "the here and now."
